A student investigates the reaction of magnesium powder with dilute hydrochloric  acid. The
magnesium is in excess.
Mg  +  2HCl→  MgCl2  +  H2
The rate of reaction can be found by measuring the increase in volume of hydrogen with time.
The results are shown on the graph.
